sports.title: Sports
sports.description: Sports to pull: football, tennis, basketball, hockey, american-football, baseball, handball, rugby, rugby-league, volleyball, cricket, darts, snooker, esports, mma, boxing, golf, table-tennis, futsal, aussie-rules and more.

days.title: Days
days.description: Days relative to today (UTC): 0 = today, -1 = yesterday, 1 = tomorrow. Flashscore keeps -7 to +7.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: Keep only leagues whose name or country contains one of these, e.g. Premier League, ENGLAND, LaLiga, NBA, Champions League, ATP. Empty = every league.

teams.title: Teams or players
teams.description: Keep only matches with one of these team or player names (partial match), e.g. Arsenal, Real Madrid, Sinner.

matchIds.title: Match IDs or URLs
matchIds.description: Specific Flashscore matches: the 8-character ID or the match URL. Up to 500.

includeStats.title: Match stats (xG, shots, possession)
includeStats.description: Add xG, xGOT, shots, possession, corners, cards, passes and every other stat Flashscore shows. Charged as match details.

includeOdds.title: Bookmaker odds
includeOdds.description: Add opening and current odds from every bookmaker Flashscore lists for your country, plus the best price per outcome. Charged as match details.

oddsMarkets.title: Odds markets
oddsMarkets.description: HOME_DRAW_AWAY (1X2), HOME_AWAY (moneyline for tennis, basketball and other no-draw sports), OVER_UNDER, BOTH_TEAMS_TO_SCORE, ASIAN_HANDICAP, EUROPEAN_HANDICAP, DOUBLE_CHANCE, DRAW_NO_BET, CORRECT_SCORE, HALF_FULL_TIME, ODD_OR_EVEN. Empty = all.

oddsScope.title: Odds period
oddsScope.description: FULL_TIME, FIRST_HALF, SECOND_HALF, FIRST_SET, SECOND_SET. Empty = all.

oddsCountry.title: Bookmaker country
oddsCountry.description: Two-letter country code that decides which bookmakers are listed, e.g. GB, US, DE, KE, NG, AU.

includeEvents.title: Goals, cards and substitutions
includeEvents.description: Add the match timeline: minute, team, player and type of every goal, card and substitution. Charged as match details.

includeH2H.title: Head-to-head and form
includeH2H.description: Add each team's last matches and their previous meetings. Charged as match details.

maxMatches.title: Max matches
maxMatches.description: Cap on rows returned (earliest kick-off first). Controls cost.
